relationToShippedSuite: test/UniPoolerCutoverEscrow.t.sol already ships invariant_outflowsOnlyToProtocol and invariant_operatorNeverReceivesAndNoAllowanceSurvives (its handler mints donations from thin air and has no pair.mint/skim/swaps and no Balancer swaps). P1 re-uses the shipped allow-list under a new adversarial handler; P2-P8 are new.

invariants.name: property_P1_custodyOutflowsOnlyToProtocol
invariants.description: Every transfer OUT of the escrow (BPT/sUSDS/phUSD/USDS) goes to the v3 router (BPT), the pair (sUSDS/phUSD seed), the sUSDS vault (USDS deposit) or oldPooler (abort). Carried from the shipped suite and re-run under the funded-donor handler.

invariants.name: property_P2_seedPostStateExact
invariants.description: After a successful exitAndSeed: escrow BPT/sUSDS/phUSD == 0; escrow USDS unchanged; BPT supply fell by exactly the escrow's BPT; reserves == pair balances == escrow pre-strays + exit proceeds per side; newPooler sUSDS/phUSD rose by exactly the pre-call unsynced pair balances (skim); newPooler LP rose by exactly the returned liquidity (>0) and LP supply == liquidity+1000; oldPooler and operator untouched.

invariants.name: property_P2b_seedAtMostOnce
invariants.description: exitAndSeed succeeds at most once (the shipped suite has the same check).

invariants.name: property_P3_abortExactToOldPooler
invariants.description: After abort: escrow holds 0 of all four tokens; oldPooler's balance of each rose by exactly the escrow's prior balance; newPooler, pair, v3, BPT supply and LP unchanged.

invariants.name: property_P4_donorNeverGainsFromForeignFlows
invariants.description: Donor (0xBAD, funded once at construction and never minted to again) balances of BPT/sUSDS/phUSD/USDS/LP equal a ghost ledger updated ONLY by the donor's own actions (donations, pair sync/skim/dust-mint/swaps, Balancer-mock swaps/exits). Any change from an operator or escrow flow breaks it.

invariants.name: property_P4b_ownerOperatorNeverReceives
invariants.description: Operator (== old-pooler owner in the fixture) never holds BPT/sUSDS/phUSD/USDS or pair LP (LP is new compared with the shipped suite).

invariants.name: property_P5_nonOperatorRevertsExactly
invariants.description: exitAndSeed (both modes)/wrapUsds/abort called by the donor, oldPooler, newPooler, v3, pair, OTHER_LP or the handler revert with exactly NotOperator(caller) returndata and leave every tracked balance unchanged.

invariants.name: property_P6_supplyConservation
invariants.description: For BPT, sUSDS, phUSD, USDS and pair LP: the sum of balances over the closed holder set == totalSupply (no value leaks to any address outside the system).

invariants.name: property_P7_abortAlwaysLive
invariants.description: Operator abort never reverts (the escape hatch is always available).

invariants.name: property_P7b_wrapLiveWhenUsdsHeld
invariants.description: wrapUsds never reverts while the escrow holds USDS.

invariants.name: property_P7c_seedLiveWhenPreconditionsHold
invariants.description: exitAndSeed never reverts when escrow BPT>0, pair reserves are 0, the pool mode is usable, the deadline is in the window, mins<=live preview, and sqrt(seedS*seedP)>1000.

invariants.name: property_P8_wrapExact
invariants.description: wrapUsds: escrow USDS -> 0, shares == amt*100/105 credited to newPooler, vault USDS += amt, other escrow balances unchanged.

controls.name: canary_notAllPathsReached
controls.description: Anti-vacuity tripwire: false once one sequence has reached seed success, a value-moving abort, an operator exitAndSeed revert, a non-operator call and a Balancer-mock swap.

controls.name: Run22MutantDivertHandler (mutant A)
controls.description: Handler action that moves escrow tokens to the donor via prank(escrow).

controls.name: Run22MutantAbortHandler (mutant B)
controls.description: Code mutant: _returnAll pays newPooler instead of oldPooler.

candidateRefinements: Candidate (2), 'escrow holds 0 of all four tokens after exitAndSeed', was narrowed to BPT/sUSDS/phUSD == 0 plus USDS unchanged. exitAndSeed never touches USDS by design (wrapUsds is the USDS path), so asserting USDS==0 would be a false property, not a finding.

Candidate (6), donor non-increase, is implemented as an exact ghost ledger, which is stronger than non-increasing. The donor's own swaps legitimately increase one token, so per-token non-increase across a whole sequence is not a valid property; the ledger isolates foreign flows.
